lines.t: Time for my milk run, {name}! My wagon is out on the road.
Folks will stop us with orders. Help me get each one right.
Hello out there! I'm Farmer Hank. I'm stuck on this side of my own gate!
The Smudge locked it with a pouring puzzle. Each lock is a pail. Fill each one exactly, and the gate opens.
You opened it! Welcome to Hilltop Dairy, {name}.
Last night the Smudge knocked over our Gallon-Man statue and drained the cows' trough.
Help me put him back together. Each dairy job on your page puts back one piece.
The locks are on the gate, {name}!
Thank you for the cream bottles! But the Smudge blew through my dairy shop.
It mixed up my labels. Some say fl oz, and some say oz. Please sort them into my two bins by the barn.
HOLDS is for fluid ounces: how much something holds. WEIGHS is for ounces: how heavy something is. Walk onto a sparkle to pick one up.
Every label is in the right bin. Thank you, {name}!
The Gallon-Man stands again, and his plaque is right. Thank you!
Now my cows are thirsty. The trough holds 6 gal 1 qt, and my pail holds 1 quart. How many pails will fill it? Go to the trough and fill it.
Hello! I'm Farmer Hank. My gate is locked, so I can't come out!
Welcome to Hilltop Dairy! We pour everything here: cups, pints, quarts and gallons.
My milk wagon!
Every order delivered, and every one exactly right!
I'll head back up to the barn. See you at the Gallon-Man, {name}.
